# C4 Level 1 — System Context

This folder contains the output from the `/c4-context` skill.

## Contents (generated by agent)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `system-context.md` | System Context document with Actors table, External Systems table, Mermaid C4Context diagram, OCPP/OCPI spec notes |
| `system-context.drawio` | draw.io XML version of the System Context diagram |

## Run `/c4-context` to generate these files.
